overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee reviewed the status of past CPA-funded projects, received an update on available funding for the current grant cycle, and evaluated scenario options for prioritizing FY23 funding requests. No formal grant award recommendations were finalized during the meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee postponed approval of prior meeting minutes because they were not yet available.

items.title: Past CPA Project Updates
items.summary: Committee members and staff reviewed the current progress, completions, and delays across previously funded CPA projects.

items.title: CPA Financial Update and Available Revenue
items.summary: Staff presented a financial summary detailing approximately $2.26 million in certified reserves and revenue available to make funding awards during the current funding cycle.

items.title: FY23 Funding Requests Review and Prioritization
items.summary: The committee discussed options and potential cost adjustments for several proposed projects to align total funding recommendations with available funds.
